name: Nexthop
author: Extreme Labs
description: Splits your Wi-Fi from your ISP, hop by hop. Continuous latency, jitter and loss on both legs of your connection, with history, outage detection and speed tests.

barWidget.description: Connection quality on the bar; click for latency, speed, Wi-Fi and outage history split by leg

schema.label: What the bar shows
schema.description: Index is the 0-100 score. Lag is the current round trip in milliseconds. Sparkline draws the last 30 samples.

schema.label: Internet anchor
schema.description: The host pinged past your router. Its latency minus the router's is your ISP leg.

schema.label: Probe interval (ms)
schema.description: 500 ms is two samples a second, about 11 MB a day. Raise it to use less.

schema.label: Measure content speed automatically
schema.description: A short ranged download that scores Speed honestly. Roughly 15 MB per check.

schema.label: Peak speed test engine
schema.description: Auto prefers the official speedtest CLI when it is installed, then Cloudflare, then fast.com. Peak tests only ever run when you ask for one.

schema.label: Plan download (Mbps)
schema.description: Optional. When set, Speed is scored against your plan (ISP accountability) instead of the built-in experience curve and your own baseline.

schema.label: Plan upload (Mbps)
schema.description: Optional, used together with the plan download.

schema.label: Throughput averaging window (seconds)
schema.description: The receiving/sending numbers average over this window. Larger is calmer, smaller is livelier.

schema.label: Notify on outage and recovery
schema.description: One notification when a disruption starts, one when it clears, naming the leg that failed.

schema.label: Tell me when an update is published
schema.description: Once a day, asks the repository you installed from whether a newer version exists, and shows a small marker in the panel if so. It never installs anything and sends nothing about you. Turn it off and no check is made.

schema.label: Keep per-minute history for (days)
schema.description: Hourly rollups are kept for a year regardless.
